_: This repository's own declared quality gates — the checks it already runs, declared at their CURRENT measured values on 2026-09-15 (S20, the quality-ratchet slice; tightened to the new measured values on 2026-09-16, S22) so the ratchet starts where the repo is. Held by starter-kit/quality_ratchet.py --precommit, chained into .githooks/pre-commit: a commit that lowers any `min` below, raises any `max`, or removes a gate is refused; tightening and adding pass. Loosening is a plan-mode decision in its own commit with the reason in CHANGELOG.md, committed with --no-verify (SAFEGUARDS.md Blast Radius Limits). Measure with `python3 starter-kit/quality_ratchet.py --run` (about three minutes: it runs bin/tests.sh) and cite the summary line in the close-out receipt (HANDOFFS.md, runtime_smoke); bin/check-handoff lints for it.
_first_tightening_owed: DISCHARGED 2026-09-16 (S23, the first commit after PR #82 merged): `tests-sh-failed` tightened 1 -> 0 and `tests-sh-passed` 138 -> 139 once Test 9 turned green on main. Kept as the record of why the failed-count gate exists: a count gate is blind to health (a failing test still ran), so the FAILED count, held at 0, is what makes the suite's colour a gate. The next tightening is owed whenever a measured value rises: run --run, read the table, raise the floors — never lower them.
_fork_tightening: FORK-ONLY, D2 of docs/planning/upstream-resync-2026-09-plan.md (S177, 2026-09-16), after this fork merged upstream/main 6b29d3d: tests-sh-passed 139 -> 327 and dashboard-unit-tests 226 -> 336, the values `quality_ratchet.py --run` measured in a --no-local clone of f4a8ec6 (10/10 pass, results 508b2b5489f3). The other count gates already sat at their measured values (118, 123, 45) and every max gate at 0. tests-sh-passed IS MEASURED WITH HANDOFFS.md HOLDING TWO RECEIPTS, the state every close-out leaves: bin/tests.sh Test 34 turns six rows into stated skips below three receipts, so the same tree reads 333 right after a claim and 327 at close-out. A floor taken at the higher state would refuse every close-out.
_fork_loosening_d10: FORK-ONLY LOOSENING, operator-approved (S178, 2026-09-16, BL-57 P5 decision D10): tests-sh-passed 327 -> 294. Removing the pre-commit hook's Phase 1B claim carve-out removed bin/tests.sh Test 27, 34 rows that tested only the carve-out; the same merge added 1 row (Test 20 (b2)). 294 is what `quality_ratchet.py --run` measured with HANDOFFS.md holding two receipts, the state a trimmed ledger returns to, in a --no-local clone of 1664860 with GitHub reachable (Test 9 passing; tests-sh-failed 0; results 839fb8a9f80a). Committed with --no-verify, as this manifest requires for a loosening; the reason is in CHANGELOG.md.
